t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Keep fingers on the s and k keys to make sure you don't run out of time. Use the breaks as the task can get tiring. They didn't notice much difference in the colours of the knomes and mushrooms picked but weren't very lucky with blue and green but might just be chance

vb_textbox.text: Keep your fingers on the keys to be as quick as possible. Use the breaks provided so you don't get too tired. I don't know if the colour of gnome picked matters, I tended to choose orange over green, purple over brown, pink over red and blue over yellow but they didn't always do well. I tried to find a pattern in something other than colour but had no luck. Good luck!
